name: Delta Electronics
h1: Scaling for AI data centres, with every program connected
lede: Delta is scaling power and liquid cooling capacity through a roughly NT$70 billion capex year and new modular AI data centre offerings. Airtable links the project, procurement and launch work behind that growth.
why_h2: An AI investment cycle that moves fast
why_p: Record capex, new product launches and a busy event calendar all add work that crosses engineering, operations, finance and marketing.

signals.title: Rapid expansion on AI infrastructure demand
signals.body: Delta Electronics set out plans for rapid expansion as AI infrastructure demand fuels growth.
signals.angle: Fast capacity expansion needs one live view of sites, suppliers and milestones.

signals.title: Prefabricated AI modular data centre launched
signals.body: At COMPUTEX 2026 Delta launched a prefabricated AI modular data centre with 800 VDC in-row power and liquid cooling for NVIDIA Vera Rubin systems, cutting IT build time by about 60 percent.
signals.angle: Cross-line launches spanning power and cooling run better on a shared NPI tracker.

signals.title: Capex guided to about NT$70 billion
signals.body: First-half capex was NT$27.5 billion with full-year guidance of about NT$70 billion, up from NT$46.6 billion last year. Liquid cooling is expected to reach at least 12 percent of revenue.
signals.angle: Capex reviews go faster when project, procurement and finance data are linked.

signals.title: AI data centre and microgrid showcase
signals.body: Delta showed its AI modular data centre with 800 VDC in-row power and microgrid solutions at Data Center World Asia 2026.
signals.angle: Event leads, follow-ups and pipeline can live in one workflow marketing and sales share.
signals.src: PR Newswire via Manila Times, 29 Sep 2026
